items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Lloyd Ignatius was dancing and so forth.

ctx.x: Yeah, in the sepia magazine. And they had, well, they had such shows there as they had female impersonator shows and people dancing with snakes and fire. I can remember Maddie Campbell was the snake dancer. Frim Fram was the fire dancer. He put fire and shot it out of the mouth and so forth. Lloyd Ignatius was dancing and so forth. It was a big show that would go on there, you know, and people would come from all over the city to come to this club. It was a black night club in the six bar, where it used to be.…
